payload.unit_title: R21 Drawing Hall Workspace View and 4 Print Templates (M2.7)
payload.objective: Report findings of read-only analysis M2.7-ANALYZE-001; propose sub-500-line Blade decomposition, master shell integration, and request authorization to begin Slice 1 implementation.
payload.explicit_request: Completed read-only analysis for M2.7. Proposed modular sub-500-line decomposition into workspace layout and 8 partials, plus 4 print templates using <x-layouts.report-layout>. Requesting PLAN_APPROVED decision authorizing M2.7 Slice 1.

task_report.summary: Completed read-only forensic analysis of M2.7 (R21 Drawing Hall Workspace View and 4 Print Templates). Formulated legacy functional inventory, M2.6 contract mapping, modular sub-500-line Blade decomposition, master shell integration (<x-layouts.workspace-layout>, <x-layouts.report-layout>), <x-ui.*> component reuse map, and two-slice implementation plan.

tests.output: Tests: 64 passed (473 assertions) in 5.05s. Zero regressions.

payload.reason: The M2.7 forensic analysis is complete, read-only, and consistent with the established migration architecture. M2.6 provides the required backend/view contract, so the proposed workspace-first implementation is appropriately scoped. The legacy 1,437-line workspace is correctly decomposed into a root workspace view plus eight focused partials, with every proposed Blade file remaining below the mandatory 500-line ceiling. The workspace is explicitly constrained to <x-layouts.workspace-layout>, while all four statutory print outputs are constrained to <x-layouts.report-layout>. The component mapping correctly replaces legacy Bootstrap, Font Awesome, raw tables, ad-hoc controls, and duplicated styling with existing <x-ui.*> infrastructure. Slice 1 is therefore authorized to implement the workspace and its modular partials only; the four print templates remain reserved for Slice 2. No control-plane or database changes are required for this approval, and the reported clean working tree and zero-regression baseline are sufficient to proceed.
